summary:
R3 is the sharpest blade on the board right now — 58-29 (67%, +28.0u) over the last 14 days on strong plays, comfortably ahead of R1's 49-26 and R2's 49-29 in the same window, and it's the only rating carrying a HOT flag on both runs (+5.4pts) and trends (+6.1pts) simultaneously. All four ratings share the trends HOT signal at 62% (108-66, n=174), and trends+runs remains the top category combo at 57.3% (302-225, n=527) — that combo is worth weighting heavily on any consensus play today. Bullpen_fatigue stays ice cold across the board at 42% (73-101, n=174) for R1/R2/R3 and R4 alike; if a game's edge is being driven by fatigue numbers alone, discount it hard.

Today's board is loaded with strong 4-way consensus, and the BOS and LAD spots are the ones to lean into given team-level trends: BOS is 78% (35-10, n=45) when picked and 79% (19-5, +18.0u) on strong plays, and today's SEA @ BOS carries the single largest average delta on the slate (R4 at +1.95, all four ratings north of +1.1) — that's trends+sp overlap territory (Bryan Woo starting) working in BOS's favor on a rating that's hot in both categories. LAD @ home vs STL is nearly as clean: model likes LAD across the board (+0.89 to +1.20) and LAD strong plays are running 18-4 (82%, +20.0u) on the season, the best team-when-liked mark in the sample. CHW @ HOU is the fade to trust the other direction — CHW is a weak 45% (14-17, n=31) pick team overall and strong plays are -3.0u, yet all four ratings pile on CHW here (-1.00 to -1.65); treat that as a spot where the model's team-blind rating math may be overstating the number. The three SPLIT games — MIL/CHC, ATL/WSN, SFG/PIT — all show sub-0.5 deltas with disagreement between ratings, so pass or minimize stake; none clear the bar that today's genuine CONSENSUS plays (BOS, MIN, KCR, TBR, LAD, TEX) are clearing.
